cap: Three breast cancer patterns are recognized by appearance. Ductal carcinoma in situ fills the duct as solid, cribriform, papillary or comedo growth, and the comedo type calcifies on mammography. Paget disease of the nipple is a crusted nipple in which carcinoma cells spread into the epidermis from an underlying ductal carcinoma in situ or invasive cancer. Inflammatory carcinoma is tumor emboli plugging dermal lymphatics, giving a red breast with peau d'orange skin.
